subject: [PATCH v3 03/11] mm, swap: prepare the swap IO path for vswap

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch prepares the Linux kernel's swap IO path to support virtual swap (vswap) by allowing it to submit IO for a swap entry other than folio->swap. The sector is computed from an explicit entry and passed through various functions, enabling batching of both vswap entries and physical entries mapped directly into PTEs. Although there are no functional changes yet, this patch sets the stage for adding a physical swap backend for vswap.
